notes.title: Patch Notes v1.10.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed startup resolution if no game is running.
- Added much needed Credits

notes.title: V1.10.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
V1.10.1
- Fixed issues where panels would get stuck behind the Top speed or Drift indicator in the middle of the screen.
- Changed active window identity to look for exact names vs begins with so GrumpyTunes stops showing over things like a discord channel for "Forza Horizon 5"

notes.title: v1.10 Patch notes
notes.notes:
V1.10
- Add support for Forza Motorsport 7. Dash packet type and must ran as a window.
- Slightly enlarged the Tire Temps (small) and added the temp numbers.
- Added metric temperatures
- Made game inputs into it's own panel vs a toggle from the compact info.
- Cleaned up Overlay/Window mode code.
	Overlay Mode	
		if Detected game is full screen, size GT to the game
		if Detected game is windowed, size GT to the desktop.
	Windowed Mode
		if Detected game is windowed, size GT to the primary display.

notes.title: v1.09 Tire Temps Update
notes.notes:
- Updated Live suspension to show tire temps larger and Color coded.
- Added a miniature tire temps panel on by default. Shows temp by color.

notes.title: Update v1.08
notes.notes:
Direction of motion indicator (Drift angle) also useful on road racing as it only shows if the angle if > 5%
Replaced Drag Times option with new Time Slip.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.07
notes.notes:
V1.07
- Added new controller inputs display from the compact tach panel. It shows Steering, H. Brake, Clutch, Brake and Acceleration inputs graphically.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.06 Update
notes.notes:
V1.06
- No data popup now shows local IP Address and 127.0.0.1
- Added setting to toggle run as Overlay/Desktop App
	- desktop mode adds a RPM background, needle center, and current gear.
- Fixed live suspension graph displaying incorrectly over time.

notes.title: Patch notes V1.05
notes.notes:
(v1.05) - Fixed some controller/gamepad buttons we're interacting with GT.
(v1.05) - Added link buttons for our Website, Discord, Youtube and Twitch.

notes.title: Patch notes V1.04
notes.notes:
V1.04
- New Drag Panel for 0-60, 0-100, 0-200 times. Adding distance. Adding multiples previous times. Removed times from compact tach.
- Added setting to turn on/off max speed popup and shift Indicator.
- New Decoder>> and Convert>> button for expanded geartuning panel. 
	- Decoder - Opens a gear decoding panel decode the current cars gear ratios.
	- Convert - Opens a gear converter to specify the final drive you want.with user input FD, so it will convert suggested GTune to the Final Drive you want.
	- Gear Decoder is now a sub panel of gear tuning just like the gear converter. Removed toggle from setting panel.
